content.title: Explore High Point: Home Furnishings Capital of the World
content.text: Skip to contentAbout High Point About High PointFounded in 1859 and named for its location at the highest point along the North Carolina Railroad between Goldsboro and Charlotte, High Point has always been a place where connections matter. What began as a strategic crossroads has grown into a dynamic city known for creativity, innovation, and momentum where history and progress move forward together.Today, High Point welcomes visitors with an energized downtown, nationally recognized events, family friendly attractions, and a spirit rooted in hospitality and design.A Global Destination with Local HeartHigh Point is home to world class events that draw visitors from across the globe, most notably High Point Market, the largest wholesale home furnishings trade show in the world. Each April and October, more than 75,000 designers, buyers, architects, and creatives from over 110 countries gather in downtown High Point to discover the latest trends in furnishings and design.Beyond Market, visitors come to experience High Point University, attend signature events like the John Coltrane International Jazz & Blues Festival; and enjoy a city that offers connectivity, thoughtful service, and room to explore at an easy pace.A Downtown on the RiseHigh Point’s revitalized Downtown District has become a walkable hub for sports, dining, arts, and nightlife.Truist Point Stadium, anchors downtown as the home of the High Point Rockers baseball team and Carolina Core FC, creating year-round energy and community pride. Nearby, Stock + Grain Assembly, Food Hall offers a curated mix of local flavors, while Congdon Yards blends historic architecture with modern workspaces, dining, and culture. Visitors can also explore The Art Gallery at Congdon Yards, featuring rotating exhibitions.As the day winds down, downtown comes alive with restaurants, live music, and the city’s social district, inviting visitors to gather, linger, and connect. Just blocks away, Uptowne High Point adds even more nightlife and dining options, including rooftop experiences.Designed for Discovery at Every AgeHigh Point offers engaging experiences for visitors of all ages. Families can explore The Nido and Mariana Qubein Children’s Museum, an interactive space that inspires curiosity and learning through play.At City Lake Park, new amenities elevate outdoor fun with a swimming pool, water slides, and a lazy river, alongside old time favorites like the train ride, mini golf, playgrounds, and scenic lake views. A new pedestrian crosswalk now connects the park directly to the High Point Greenway, creating easy access to even more outdoor exploration.Visitors can discover even more green spaces through the Piedmont Discovery App, which highlights 40 nearby parks and trails. High Point University’s beautifully landscaped campus also offers gardens, sculptures, cultural performances, and athletic events open to the public throughout the year.Where History Inspires the PresentHigh Point’s story is rooted in innovation, entrepreneurship, and social progress. At the High Point Museum, visitors can explore the city’s legacy in home furnishings, business leadership, and civil rights history. A visit to Mendenhall Homeplace offers a powerful glimpse into the past, including one of only two remaining false bottom wagons used on the Underground Railroad.Home Furnishings Capital of the WorldTMKnown worldwide as the Home Furnishings Capital of the WorldTM, High Point offers access to more than 1,000 home furnishings brands, making it a premier destination for design inspiration. Visitors can explore 80 furniture stores and outlets across the region, along with year-round showrooms that showcase the depth, diversity, and innovation of the furnishings industry.High Point is also home to Furnitureland South, the largest furniture store in the nation, further reinforcing the city’s unmatched scale and influence in home design.A Place to Visit and BelongWith its central Piedmont location just an hour from the mountains and three hours from the coast, High Point is as easy to visit as it is to love. Positioned between Greensboro and Winston Salem, the city blends small city warmth with big picture opportunity.High Point is proud to be both a Retire NC Certified Community and a Certified Autism Destination, reflecting a citywide commitment to accessibility, inclusion, and welcoming experiences for all visitors.Share Your High Point ExperienceWe have shared what we love about High Point. Now it is your turn. On your next trip, show us how you VisitHP by tagging VisitHighPoint and sharing your experience.
